# Contributing to Multron Win Cleaner

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Multron Win Cleaner!

## How to Contribute
- **Rule Database:** Add or update cleaning definitions in the [MultronWcleaner-Database](https://github.com/winball501/MultronWcleaner-Database) repository.
- **Bug Reports:** Open an issue providing OS version, steps to reproduce, and unexpected behavior.
- **Code & UI:** Open a PR against the `beta` branch. Keep changes modular and focused.

## Pull Request Guidelines
1. Fork the repository and create your feature branch.
2. Ensure your changes build cleanly.
3. Provide a clear PR title and summary of changes.
